seo_description: Christmas events for kids in Newport Beach for 2026: the 118th Christmas Boat Parade, Balboa Bay Resort tree lighting, Sherman Gardens Merry & Bright Nights and Fashion Island Santa, dates checked on host sites.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Newport Beach for 2026, and here is what he found: 15 family events. The magic runs from November 27 (Holiday Tree Lighting at Pendry Newport Beach) through the 118th Newport Beach Christmas Boat Parade in mid December, with the Balboa Bay Resort tree lighting (November 29), Merry & Bright Nights at Sherman Library & Gardens (December 3 to 22) and Santa at Fashion Island along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Newport Beach

  • 15 Christmas events for kids in Newport Beach (7 already live, 4 moved over from the Irvine page and 4 new)
  • New: Balboa Bay Resort tree lighting (November 29), Pendry tree lighting (November 27), Merry & Bright Nights at Sherman Library & Gardens and the Holiday Open House at Corona del Mar Library (December 6)
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa at Fashion Island, Santa on stage at Balboa Bay Resort and Santa at Sherman Gardens
  • Also on the list: the Christmas Boat Parade, Nights of Coastal Lights, Crystal Cove tree lighting and Hyatt holiday events
  • Season: November 27 to the Boat Parade nights December 16 to 20

Planning a bigger day out? Newport Beach families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Anaheim, which covers Holidays at the Disneyland Resort, Knott's Merry Farm, Anaheim Ballet's Nutcracker and the Anaheim tree lighting.
